faqs.question: What does 🌋🔥 mean from an ex?
faqs.answer: From an ex 🌋🔥 can read either as reaction to a public post or as a re-open coded signal. The combo is ambiguous in a 1:1 thread.

faqs.question: Can 🌋🔥 be sarcastic?
faqs.answer: Yes — reaction-coded pairs often carry sarcasm when the partner emoji is an angry or unimpressed face. Watch the lead-up.

faqs.question: Is 🌋🔥 passive-aggressive?
faqs.answer: Reaction-coded combos sometimes mask passive aggression. Watch the lead-up; if the sender was annoyed before, the emoji might be the residue.

faqs.question: Is 🌋🔥 ever ironic?
faqs.answer: Yes — reaction-coded combos can flip ironic when paired with text that contradicts the cue. The combo does not always match the message.
